claim: In the stock exe code: a ship is a SHIP object (0x2120 bytes, ctor 0x691c10, vtable 0x1338780), not a UNIT: position x,y,z = SHIP+0x54 (vtable slot 0 lea eax,[ecx+0x54]); orientation 3x3 at SHIP+0x504, heading = atan2([+0x50c], [+0x524]) as the engine bearing getter computes it; sail level float +0x1b88 (> 0.5 full 8, > 0.25 half 4, > 0 battle 2, else stationary 1); orderable when bytes +0x20dd and +0x20de are 0, [+0x1c58] != 2 and not routing; surrendered [+0x1f00] == 4; hull damage mean of +0x1d80..+0x1d8c; sail damage +0x1d90
notes: static (stock exe sha1 9aebcd21..., disassembly with re/j60re.py); the runtime meaning is open in napoleon.battle.ship_orders (owner: J60 PC slot); sites battle.ship_vtable_store, ship_position_slot, ship_bearing_get, ship_sail_get, ship_orderable, ship_surrendered_get
